hypothesis: A second generative formatter can change explicit first-pass semantic relations. Preserve unambiguous draft conclusions with a deterministic three-way mapping; missing is not refutation.
design_status: Post-hoc development fix after inspecting3wrong cases; not independent validation or a new model result.
policy: Decode only explicit relation JSON or standalone final answer after closing think tag. Reject conflicting labels, unknown explicit labels, wrong proposition echoes, and multiple-source binding. Fall back to original formatter only when no explicit draft conclusion exists.
source_scope: One permitted passage only; index0binding does not prove entailment or provenance. No draft added as evidence.
labels: Unchanged original human labels, no filtering or case-specific rules
gate: Development accuracy gain>=.02 over original reasoning-first, correct-definitive fraction nonregression, coverage>=.35. No public promotion even if passed.
resources: Cached model drafts;0new model calls or cloud spend. Any foregone formatter latency is counterfactual, not a measured new workflow.
